# Problem 1 - OOP Programming

## (a) Defining the waldCI Class

```{r}
setClass(
  "waldCI",
  slots = c(
    estimate = "numeric",
    sterr = "numeric",
    level = "numeric",
    lower = "numeric",
    upper = "numeric"
  )
)

```

```{r}
#' Validate a Wald confidence interval
#'
#' @param object A waldCI object
#' @return TRUE if valid, otherwise an error message
setValidity("waldCI", function(object) {
  lengths <- c(
    length(object@estimate),
    length(object@sterr),
    length(object@level),
    length(object@lower),
    length(object@upper)
  )

  if (any(lengths != 1)) {
    return("All slots must contain exactly one value.")
  }

  values <- c(
    object@estimate,
    object@sterr,
    object@level,
    object@lower,
    object@upper
  )

  if (any(!is.finite(values))) {
    return("All values must be finite.")
  }

  if (object@sterr < 0) {
    return("Standard error must be nonnegative.")
  }

  if (object@level <= 0 || object@level >= 1) {
    return("Confidence level must be between 0 and 1.")
  }

  if (object@lower > object@upper) {
    return("Lower bound cannot exceed upper bound.")
  }

  z <- qnorm((1 - object@level) / 2, lower.tail = FALSE)

  expected <- object@estimate + c(-1, 1) * z * object@sterr

  if (any(!is.finite(expected))) {
    return("The implied confidence bounds must be finite.")
  }

  actual <- c(object@lower, object@upper)

  if (!isTRUE(all.equal(actual, expected, tolerance = 1e-10))) {
    return("Confidence bounds are inconsistent with the estimate and standard error.")
  }

  TRUE
})

```

```{r}
#' Construct a Wald confidence interval
#'
#' @param level Confidence level between 0 and 1
#' @param mean Point estimate, if supplied
#' @param sterr Standard error, if supplied
#' @param lb Lower confidence bound, if supplied
#' @param ub Upper confidence bound, if supplied
#' @return A validated waldCI object
makeWaldCI <- function(level, mean = NULL, sterr = NULL,
                       lb = NULL, ub = NULL) {

  if (!is.numeric(level) || length(level) != 1 ||
      !is.finite(level) || level <= 0 || level >= 1) {
    stop("Confidence level must be a finite number between 0 and 1.")
  }

  from_stats <- !is.null(mean) && !is.null(sterr) &&
    is.null(lb) && is.null(ub)

  from_bounds <- !is.null(lb) && !is.null(ub) &&
    is.null(mean) && is.null(sterr)

  if (!from_stats && !from_bounds) {
    stop("Supply either mean and sterr, or lb and ub.")
  }

  z <- qnorm((1 - level) / 2, lower.tail = FALSE)

  if (from_stats) {
    if (!is.numeric(mean) || length(mean) != 1 ||
        !is.finite(mean)) {
      stop("Mean must be a single finite number.")
    }

    if (!is.numeric(sterr) || length(sterr) != 1 ||
        !is.finite(sterr) || sterr < 0) {
      stop("Standard error must be a single nonnegative finite number.")
    }

    lb <- mean - z * sterr
    ub <- mean + z * sterr
  }

  if (from_bounds) {
    if (!is.numeric(lb) || length(lb) != 1 ||
        !is.finite(lb) ||
        !is.numeric(ub) || length(ub) != 1 ||
        !is.finite(ub)) {
      stop("Confidence bounds must be finite numbers.")
    }

    if (lb > ub) {
      stop("Lower bound cannot exceed upper bound.")
    }

    mean <- (lb + ub) / 2
    sterr <- (ub - lb) / (2 * z)
  }

  object <- new(
    "waldCI",
    estimate = as.numeric(mean),
    sterr = as.numeric(sterr),
    level = as.numeric(level),
    lower = as.numeric(lb),
    upper = as.numeric(ub)
  )

  validObject(object)

  return(object)
}

```

```{r}
test_ci1 <- makeWaldCI(
  level = 0.95,
  lb = 17.2,
  ub = 24.7
)

test_ci2 <- makeWaldCI(
  level = 0.99,
  mean = 13,
  sterr = 2.5
)

is(test_ci1, "waldCI")
is(test_ci2, "waldCI")

validObject(test_ci1)
validObject(test_ci2)

slotNames(test_ci1)

```
